rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst with compact ICM and no obvious degeneration, but is inconsistent on expansion stage and speculates about sparse TE and hatching/hatched appearance that may not be clearly supported from a single image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, prior IVF outcomes, BMI, lifestyle, and male factor reasonably well, though some links are broad rather than deeply case-specific.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies in staging terminology, probability ranges, and some speculative comments about OHSS risk and embryo appearance.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice: emphasizes morphology limits, supports single embryo transfer, cautions against unproven add-ons, and suggests uterine review after failures; minor deviations include some loose Gardner terminology and speculative adjunct testing.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and future workup, though the future-cycle section is incomplete and some recommendations remain somewhat generic.
